review.item_premise: This body inherits the delivery decision for observation::<SummaryFields as Visit>::record_str. This body is admitted with default-versus-trace emission: absence of default payload emission does not imply missing instrumentation. RECORDS registration uses its named contract stem, retains the bounded operation identity at default level, and declares seven owner-specific instruments without widening other owners or payload capture.
